text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The world's premier race— France's Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The grand race that many racing figures 
have dreamed of drew near again this year. 
Amidst the restless buzz sweeping through 
the academy—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer! Over here~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summoned by Tazuna, I rushed to the school 
gates... only to find several trucks 
parked there.
choice_data_list: Um, what on earth is this...?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
These are all fan letters addressed to 
you, <chrname>-san!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, it reminded me of Haiseiko's 
racing days...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"Even when it's just addressed to 'To <chrname>, 
Tokyo', it gets delivered without a 
hitch!"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The fans' enthusiasm is surging 
dramatically as well――

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
――Apparently, it all started on social 
media.

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
After watching videos of the Umamusume 
passionately taking on challenges, more 
fans apparently want to show their 
support.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Meek got a fan letter too, and she was 
overjoyed about it!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
...This is a sight we couldn't have 
imagined two years ago, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, come to think of it... there was a 
time when she lamented that her fan 
letters had decreased."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fueled further by the fans' passion, the 
Umamusume's motivation grew higher with 
each passing day.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
—Next is the uphill slope. Racecourses in 
the UK have harsher elevation changes than 
Nakayama. First, let's look at your 
current data.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...If you've got something to say, say it. 
If you can't say it, keep it off your damn 
face.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Um, excuse me... Yes... I'm so 
sorry...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...Where'd that courage go from when you 
called out to me? You wanna be great, 
don'tcha?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If you rise to the top, it benefits me 
too. ...That's all there is to it. Come 
on, keep going.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeeesss!!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Sechsundneunzig ... Siebenundneunzig ... 
Achtundneunzig ... !

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ninety-nine...! One hundreeed~~!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hauaaaaa~~~~...! I-I'm so tie-yerd...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Thank you for accompanying me. 
Your stamina is truly impressive.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hieee, not at all, not at all...! Digitan 
is, well, um, just... Just...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to give it my all...! I wanted to 
live up to their expectations so 
badly...!!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I can tell. You're such a hard 
worker, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: *Gasp*

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Digital-san...?!
choice_data_list:
(Everyone's pushing each other to improve 
and doing their best)

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—Allow me to answer once more. What does 
it take to conquer the world?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
It's about all of Japan uniting as one to 
aim for the very top.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume skill, training techniques, 
environments... Everything has been 
updated compared to the past, and it's a 
fact that we're getting closer to the 
world stage.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Until the races are enveloped in even 
greater fervor. The key to that... surely 
rests in their hands.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
“—Alright, let's keep making those 
banners! We're aiming to make one for 
every single Umamusume!”

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"...Every single one of them is in high 
spirits. ............—"

text_block_list.name: A Certain Father
text_block_list.text: —Speed Symboli?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: A Certain Father
text_block_list.text: Ah! S-Sorry... Are you Sirius Symboli?

text_block_list.name: A Certain Father
text_block_list.text:
Forgive me. For some reason, I mistook it 
for... No, I am truly sorry.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: "...Are you a fan of Speed Symboli?"

text_block_list.name: A Certain Father
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah... yeah. Back then, or however I 
should put it...

text_block_list.name: A Certain Father
text_block_list.text:
"Back when Speed Symboli was actively 
running, I went all the way to France to 
cheer for her."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: A Certain Father
text_block_list.text:
"My kid recommended a bunch of things to 
me recently, so I've been watching... Man, 
they're all seriously amazing!"

text_block_list.name: A Certain Father
text_block_list.text:
It feels like I might finally get to see 
the continuation of that dream from back 
then... I'm so grateful. Thank you!

text_block_list.name: A Certain Father
text_block_list.text: It's just...—

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: “—You want us in the ‘Dream Fest’?”
choice_data_list: I really want you to run in this race!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
First was the anticipation of an all-star 
gathering... Next, the strongest Umamusume 
across generations clashed. If so, then 
what comes next is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Who is the Umamusume worthy of taking on 
the world?" This race will decide the true 
champion. In other words, the victor will 
be—

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
To forge a legend... That's why it's our 
turn to step up, right!

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: ... Go ahead and say it.
choice_data_list: Please share your feelings with us, too
Please share your feelings with us, too

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Talking directly with those legends taught 
me so much. Among those lessons—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—I learned the strength of their hearts. 
Those who achieve true results possess an 
unbreakable will that allows them to 
believe in themselves when it matters 
most."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It is precisely because they possess the 
mindset of a champion... that they came to 
be called a legend. And that is an 
essential element for taking on a great 
challenge—
choice_data_list:
I want everyone's feelings passed on to 
future generations—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The place where Umamusume can convey their 
feelings to one another most directly... 
is in a race. I want you to pass those 
feelings on to the next generation of 
girlsâ

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: ... It was you after all.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Moving forward powered by their 
feelings... That is a strength an 
Umamusume needs.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Naturally, there is only one answer.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—Let's run! In one fell swoop, surpass 
everything that came before!

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
However, we have already retired. I am 
surprised you thought we could still run.
choice_data_list: ...But you had it ready, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That was around the summer training 
camp... No, they must have started 
training little by little even before 
that."

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Actually... the three of us had talked it 
over beforehand, just in case someone 
asked that of us.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
If it's what they want, then I want to 
deliver!

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
It probably won't go like it did in my 
prime. However... that's no reason not to 
try.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
Because our beloved children are working 
so hard.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
So that the experience of running with us 
may nourish you... Let us run in a way 
worthy of our legendary names!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I feel something boiling up inside my 
heart... Knowing they will run, just 
imagine how thrilled the fans will be!
choice_data_list: We need to announce this far and wide!

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. I'd like to ask you to 
help with part of the announcement too.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I am well aware that your activities on 
the network played a major role in 
promoting the race.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"If that is the case, convey your feelings 
until the very end. I will prepare 
anything and everything you need."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The excitement that's built up so far... I 
want to create promotions that elevate it 
even further. In that case, naturally—
choice_data_list:
I'd like to get the Umamusume to help out 
as well.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...In that case, there is someone I would 
like to recommend.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: —I'd recognize you in an instant.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
People are captivated by a brilliantly 
shining star. No wonder she has so many 
adoring fans.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...You're not the type to be charmed by 
that, are you?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
It's the same thing. Sirius, I have a 
favor to ask.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Could you help me with the publicity for 
the next Dream Fest?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Why me?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Don't go calling it 'a favor between 
distant relatives.'"

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Haha, think back. If I were trying to 
make you laugh, I'd do a much better job."

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Claiming the brightest light among all 
the stars. Because it's you, you are truly 
worthy of it.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Ever challenging others, asserting that 
you are the radiant one. Your gaze, your 
words—they set people's hearts ablaze.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I believe that very resolve is the message 
that needs to be delivered.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"...I think you might laugh at this, but 
of course I have personal feelings about 
it too."

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
To you who will follow in my footsteps, I 
want to grant you light.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: It's a secret, okay?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Hah, to Rudolf? When she looks up to 
you so much, wouldn't that be a pity?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"She won't get jealous. She knows what she 
needs to do."

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you the one who gets jealous? Ever 
since way back... right?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Tch.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...I have a condition.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: “—The next race. Run with all you've got.”

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Don't settle for being just background 
noise. Show some ego.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —Come at me to win. Otherwise...—

text_block_list.name: A Certain Father
text_block_list.text: ‘However—’

text_block_list.name: A Certain Father
text_block_list.text:
"—If possible, I wanted that child... to 
dream right now."

text_block_list.name: A Certain Father
text_block_list.text:
"I wanted you to be the one standing at 
the top... ...Though I suppose it's rude 
of me to think that."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —Otherwise, it's boring.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: What's so funny?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
No, you're not strange. It's just... this 
happiness is more than I deserve.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I was blessed with a great team. I was 
able to run overseas. I was allowed to 
run... for a long, long time.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I gave it my all, from the bottom of my 
heart. ――My future has become all of you.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
And yet... I can take on a new challenge. 
Someone is even hoping for a serious 
showdown with me.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, I shall challenge it with every 
ounce of my being. Do not underestimate me 
just because I am an old man.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Hah... Talking like some old geezer.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that is it. That is all I wanted to 
hear.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"—Make sure you leave full of regrets. 
'Suu-san.'"
